title: refcheck_confirm single-Option still silently overwritten by another row's action
evidence:
RefcheckStart -> #(
          Model(
            ..menu_closed,
            refcheck_confirm: Some(model.RefcheckConfirm(
              call_id: call_id,
              kind: RefcheckConfirmStart,
            )),
          ),
detail: Choosing Start/Take-over for row B replaces row A's pending inline confirm with no user action on A — the same overwrite class r4 N1 fixed for edits via the per-row dict; no mutation is lost, but the pending choice vanishes.
recommended_fix: Either scope confirm per-row (dict like refcheck_edit) or clear it in UserChoseRefcheckAction only for the same call_id; a one-line guard on the overwrite would do.
